kpis.name: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE)
kpis.erpImpact: Real-time machine monitoring increases baseline OEE by 12-15%.

kpis.name: Manufacturing Cycle Time
kpis.description: Total time to convert raw materials into finished goods.
kpis.formula: Process Time + Move Time + Queue Time + Wait Time
kpis.erpImpact: Automated shop floor scheduling reduces queue time by 40%.

kpis.name: Inventory Turnover Ratio
kpis.description: How many times a company has sold and replaced inventory during a given period.
kpis.formula: Cost of Goods Sold / Average Inventory
kpis.erpImpact: MRP automation prevents overstocking, improving ratio by 25%.
